text: No, the property did **not** lose 67.7 ha of tree cover **after** the EUDR cut-off date (31 December 2020). The 67.7-ha loss event occurred **in 2020** (before the baseline) and is classified as a pre-baseline historical event. Post-2020, only 0.4 ha of loss was observed (in 2021), but this was in patches smaller than the 0.5-ha minimum event size threshold and was not counted as a loss event. The JRC 2020 reference confirms no forest cover remained by the baseline date.
